sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Moto Maniac are deceptively simple. Using your mouse, keyboard or touch controls, you'll navigate through a series of increasingly challenging tracks, dodging obstacles and trying to reach the finish line without crashing. As you progress through the game, the obstacles become more complex and the tracks become longer and more treacherous.

But what really sets Moto Maniac apart is its unique balance system. By leaning your bike back and forth, you'll be able to adjust your speed and balance, allowing you to navigate even the most challenging tracks with ease. With practice and patience, you'll be able to master the art of balance and become a true Moto Maniac champion.

One of the key features of Moto Maniac is its intuitive controls. Whether you're using a mouse, keyboard or touch controls, the game responds seamlessly to your input, allowing you to focus on the action on screen. With its responsive gameplay and realistic physics, Moto Maniac is the perfect game for anyone looking to experience the thrill of trial biking without the need for a real bike.
